tools.name: resolve_date
tools.status: To push: an optional string parameter time_text (the installation time as the customer said it). Without it the server still refuses Sundays and today after visiting hours; the answer now also has a time field.

tools.name: book_installation
tools.status: The server now requires preferred_time and refuses a slot outside Monday to Saturday, 10 am to 6 pm, or already passed; mark preferred_time required on the tool when it is next edited.

tools.name: send_invoice_upload_link
tools.status: Created in draft 6 on 2026-10-23, with Phase 15 and the reordered Phase 6 in the prompt. Body params: phone (required), customer_name, order_reference. Sends the WhatsApp event with phone_number and customer_name only; the integration's template carries the link to the website's /invoice page. Answers 404 until the server code is deployed to Render.

tools.name: get_product_guide
tools.status: Created and committed in version 7 on 2026-10-27, with the part-by-part Phase 7 and a Facts line. Body params: order_id, order_number, invoice_number, product_name, phone (all optional; an order reference or a product name is needed). Reads the published Product_Guide__c of the products on the order. Answers 404 until the server code is deployed to Render; the agent then falls back to find_parts.

tools.name: get_installation_address
tools.status: Endpoint written; the Sarvam tool is not created on this agent. Body params: order_id, order_number, invoice_number (all optional strings, one is needed). Also to push: book_installation gets at_delivery_address (boolean), and book_installation and register_service_request get new_request (boolean).

ids_note: Each version holds its own copy of the tools; id is the editable draft (version 8). agent-prompt.md has sections the live prompt does not have yet (Phase 0 language, the installation address flow of Phase 6, the repeat request check of Phase 5 step 7); changes are pushed to the live prompt section by section.
